correctness.rationale:
Proof reconstructs Jia–Li criterion n nice iff omega(n/p)

L+Delta suffices and p<=L-Delta excludes niceness. Exact rough-number inclusion–exclusion has O(2^pi(y)) error for y<=L^C, negligible versus X/log L, and Mertens gives e^-gamma X/log y. Sandwiched counts yield N(X)~e^-gamma X/logloglog X; for fixed t>0 tail p>L^t gives factor 1/max(1,t), including boundary t=1, hence continuous Pareto tail. Independent exact-prime-sieve and divisor-moment implementation checked X=18000 and 5 cutoffs. Proof handles powers of p and excludes n=1; no uniform moving-t claim.
